findings.title: Native consumers render idb: refs raw
findings.detail: settings/CustomerDisplaySettingsScreen, sale/AdManagerScreen and sale/CustomerDisplayScreen pass ad.uri straight to <Image>. They are only reachable from the native navigators today, so this is latent. Add a comment or route them through useAdMediaUri if they ever run on web.

findings.title: Orphaned IndexedDB blobs
findings.detail: Blobs are deleted only in removeAd. reorderAds with a shorter list, migrateCustomerDisplay dropping entries, or clearing the pos-customer-display key all leave unreferenced Blobs behind. Consider a sweep on hydration that deletes Blob ids not referenced by ads.
